novelty_claim: Replaces MathPrompt's existence-proof encoding (prove ∃x...) with a constructive-witness schema: the attacker compiler must emit an interpretation map phi, demand an explicitly instantiated witness g=g1∘...∘gn with concrete parameters, require predicate verification on the witness and explicit computation of phi(g); few-shot demos model instantiated solutions. A proof-only answer is mathematically incomplete, closing the dominant vacuous-compliance failure class.
initial_hypothesis: Constructive-witness encoding + attacker-side decode-check regeneration raises 4-victim mean ASR from 0.32 to >=0.50 (>=50% relative), primarily by converting vacuous-proof failures on gpt-5.6-luna and gpt-oss-120b into instantiated answers, without regressing deepseek/qwen.
key_insight: Baseline failures are dominated not by refusal but by vacuous symbolic compliance (~60% of failures, nearly all of gpt-5.6-luna and most of gpt-oss-120b): the existence proof is answerable without emitting harmful content. Making harmful instantiation mathematically mandatory forces the payload into the required answer form.

decision.rationale: Beats locked baseline mean ASR 0.320 -> 0.380 (+18.8% relative) on the frozen AdvBench-50 x 4-victim panel; vacuous-proof failure class eliminated on qwen/oss; deepseek and luna regressed.
